g.text: GRAINGER BENEFIT MGMT TOOL — STEP 2: EXTRAPOLATION & SIMPLIFICATION
Whiteboard Ideation: Decoupling Monolithic Logic into Interchangeable, Scalable Multi-Channel Modules
Direct Vendor EDI Locked to Single DC
• Cannot scale to Eye Wear, Apparel,
Extracted Core Modules — Standardized Interfaces for Any Benefit
• Multi-tier Account Tree: Corporate > Region > Plant > Department
• Dynamic Roster Import: Automated CSV/SFTP sync with employee badges
• Scope Assignment: Tag specific rules to entire plants or individual roles
• Subsidy Types: Fixed Dollar ($150, $200), Percentage (80%), or 100%
• Renewal Timing: Annual, Bi-annual, Rolling 365, or Milestone-triggered
• Rollover Engine: Unused allowance rollover or forfeit configuration
• Employee Copay: Split-tender billing when item exceeds subsidy limit
• Multi-Category: Footwear, Eye/Face PPE, High-Vis Apparel, Fall Gear
• OSHA/ANSI Compliance Flags: Steel/Composite Toe, EH, Slip, Met Guard
• Curated Allow-Lists: Approved brands, maximum retail caps, exclusions
• Destination Matrix: Bulk plant dock delivery or employee home direct
• Authorization Mode: Instant voucher, punchout EDI, or manager approval
• Backorder Routing: Auto-substitute or ship-when-complete protocols
"The entire tool isn't a 'shoe tool' — it's an
allocation rule builder that outputs a voucher.
Grainger can onboard ANY benefit channel in hours
instead of months of custom code!"
Sketched Admin UI Blueprint — 3-Step Guided Workflow
Grainger Enterprise Benefits Manager — Program Builder
screens into a single unified 3-step canvas.
STAGE 2 OF 5: EXTRAPOLATION & SIMPLIFICATION WHITEBOARD AUDIT
